summary: The enclosure exterior is visually coherent and the corrected 146 x 190 x 205 mm chassis envelope is supported. Internal component fit, retention, cable paths, and side-panel clearances are not directly visible in the available rendered views, so those checks remain not verified.

checks.description: The exterior assembly appears complete and consistently proportioned, with aligned side panels, top, frame, openings, and feet; no obvious floating exterior part or visible exterior collision is present.

evidence.description: The isometric view shows a coherent closed enclosure with aligned frame, top, vented side, rear openings, and feet, without an obvious exterior collision or detached part.

checks.description: The closed exterior views do not directly show the 170 x 170 mm motherboard, its retention points, or rear-I/O accessibility, so fit and retention cannot be established visually.

evidence.description: The enclosure is shown closed; the Mini-ITX board, mounting bosses, and rear-I/O relationship are obscured.

checks.description: The cooler envelope and its spacing to the intake panel are obscured by the closed enclosure, preventing direct verification of fit and intake clearance.

evidence.description: The front orthographic view shows enclosure surfaces but does not expose the installed AXP120-X67 envelope or a measurable visible air gap.

checks.description: The rendered exterior does not directly expose the rear GPU, I/O bracket retention, PCIe riser passage, or cable-bend volume; the complete interface cannot be verified.

evidence.description: The isometric exterior view leaves the rear-installed GPU and its required riser and power-routing relationships hidden.

checks.description: The closed views do not directly show the 1U PSU envelope, cradle retention, AC inlet accessibility, airflow gap, or harness route.

evidence.description: The front view shows rear-panel openings but not enough of the installed PSU or cradle to establish retention, inlet access, airflow, and routing.

checks.description: An exterior control feature may be present, but the available views do not directly establish both external button accessibility and a continuous internal route to the motherboard header.

evidence.description: The exterior is visible, but the internal power-button lead path to the motherboard header is not exposed.

checks.description: No component visibly protrudes beyond the closed exterior silhouette, but the opaque side and top surfaces conceal the cooler, GPU, and PSU interfaces; absence of side-panel or frame interpenetration cannot be directly established.

evidence.description: The rear isometric view shows a clean exterior silhouette but the relevant installed component envelopes remain concealed behind enclosure surfaces.
The opaque top view does not reveal component-to-side-panel relationships needed to rule out hidden interpenetration.

checks.description: The focused renders do not expose the AXP120-X67 boundary against the inner face of the left vent panel, so non-overlap and a visible intake gap cannot be confirmed.

evidence.description: The cooler remains hidden by the enclosure/vent panel, and no direct visual air gap is observable.

checks.description: The focused right, top, and rear-isometric views retain opaque enclosure surfaces, so the GPU and PSU boundaries relative to the right panel and rear frame cannot be directly verified.

evidence.description: The right-side exterior silhouette is intact, but the installed GPU and PSU remain obscured behind the side panel.
The rear-isometric exterior view does not reveal the hidden component-to-frame clearance boundaries.

checks.description: The chassis is visibly a widened rectangular enclosure, and supporting bbox inspection reports 146 x 190 x 205 mm, corresponding to approximately 5.69 L rather than under 4 L.

evidence.description: The isometric image directly shows the corrected widened chassis form; supporting geometry inspection gives a chassis-frame bbox from [-73,-95,0] to [73,95,205] mm, i.e. 146 x 190 x 205 mm.
